sanskrit: agnir mā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Agni with the Vasus guard me from the east. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: vāyur māntarikṣeṇa etasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Vāyu together with the Atmosphere guard me from that direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: somo mā rudrair dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Soma with the Rudras guard me from the southern direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: varuṇo mā ādityair etasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Varuṇa with the Ādityas guard me from that direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: sūryo mā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Sūrya together with Heaven-and-Earth guard me from the western direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: apo mauṣadhīmatīr etasyā diśaḥ pāntu tāsu krame tāsu śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | tā mā rakṣantu tā mā gopāyantu tābhya ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May the Waters rich in healing herbs guard me from that direction. Upon them I step forward; upon them I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May they protect me, may they keep me safe; to them I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: viśvakarmā mā saptarṣibhir udīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Viśvakarmā with the Seven Seers guard me from the northern direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: indro mā marutvān etasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Indra, attended by the Maruts, guard me from that direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: prajāpatir mā prajananavān saha pratiṣṭhayā dhruvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Prajāpati, endowed with procreative power together with the steadfast ground, guard me from the fixed (nadir) direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: bṛhaspatir mā viśvair devair ūrdhvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃ śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi | sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
english: May Bṛhaspati with all the gods guard me from the upward direction. Upon that I step forward; upon that I rest; into that stronghold I enter. May he protect me, may he keep me safe; to him I surrender myself — svāhā!

sanskrit: agniṃ te vasumantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyavaḥ prācyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the eastern direction reach Agni together with the Vasus.

sanskrit: vāyuṃ te 'ntarikṣavantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from that direction reach Vāyu together with the Atmosphere.

sanskrit: somaṃ te rudravantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyavo dakṣiṇāyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the southern direction reach Soma together with the Rudras.

sanskrit: varuṇaṃ ta ādityavantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from that direction reach Varuṇa together with the Ādityas.

sanskrit: sūryaṃ te dyāvāpṛthivīvantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyavaḥ pratīcyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the western direction reach Sūrya together with Heaven-and-Earth.

sanskrit: apas ta oṣadhīmatīr ṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from that direction reach the Waters rich in healing herbs.

sanskrit: viśvakarmāṇaṃ te saptarṣivantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyava udīcyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the northern direction reach Viśvakarman together with the Seven Seers.

sanskrit: indraṃ te marutvantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyava etasyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from that direction reach Indra together with the Maruts.

sanskrit: prajāpatiṃ te prajananavantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyavo dhruvāyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the fixed (nadir) direction reach Prajāpati endowed with procreative power.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatiṃ te viśvadevavantam ṛcchantu ye māghāyava ūrdhvāyā diśo +'bhidāsān ||
english: May those who are malicious towards you and would assail you from the upward direction reach Bṛhaspati together with all the gods.

sanskrit: vaikaṅkatenedhmena devebhya ājyaṃ vaha | agne tān iha mādaya sarva ā yantu me havam ||
english: With vaikaṅkata wood as kindling, carry the clarified butter to the gods. O Agni, gladden them here; may they all come to my call.

sanskrit: indra ā yāhi me havam idaṃ kariṣyāmi tac chṛṇu | ima aindrā atisarā ākūtīḥ saṃ namantu me | tebhiḥ śakema vīryaṃ jātavedas tanūvaśin ||
english: O Indra, come to my call; hear what I am about to do. May these ati-sara charms consecrated to Indra bend their intentions toward me. Through them may we achieve heroic power, O Jātavedas, O master of bodies.

sanskrit: yad asāv amuto devā adevaḥ saṃścikīrṣati | mā tasyāgnir havyaṃ vākṣīd dhavaṃ devāś ca mopa gur mamaiva havam etana ||
english: Whatever that impious one over there, O gods, is plotting to do — may Agni not carry his oblation; may the gods not go to his call. Come instead to my call alone.

sanskrit: ati dhāvatātisarā viśvasyeśānā ojasaḥ | vṛścatāmuṣya jīvitam indreṇa saha medinā ||
english: Run forward, O ati-sara charms, you who are lords of all strength. Cut down that one's life-force, together with Indra as your ally.

sanskrit: atisṛtyātisarā indrasyaujasā hata | aviṃ vṛka iva mathnīta tato vo jīvan mā moci prāṇam asyāpi nahyata ||
english: Having surged forward, O ati-sara charms, strike him with Indra's might. Crush him as a wolf crushes a sheep. From that point let him not be released alive; bind tight the breath of this one.

sanskrit: yān asau pratisarān akaś cakāra kṛṇavac ca yān | tvaṃ tān indra vṛtrahan pratīcaḥ punar ā kṛdhi yathāmuṃ tṛṇahañ janam ||
english: Whatever counter-charms (pratisara) that man has made or may yet make — turn them back against himself, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, so that he may be crushed, that man.

sanskrit: yam amī purodadhire brahmāṇam upabhūtaye | indrasya te adhaspadaṃ taṃ pra yacchāmi mṛtyave kravyād enaṃ śamayatu ||
english: That brahmin whom those men have installed in front for their own support — him I deliver beneath the foot of Indra for Death; let the flesh-eating one silence him.

sanskrit: yadi preyur devapurā brahma varmāṇi cakrire | tanūpānaṃ paripāṇāni cakrire sarvaṃ tad arasaṃ kṛdhi ||
english: If, having gone before, they have fashioned divine strongholds as armor, have fashioned body-guards and all-round protective shields — render all of that powerless.

sanskrit: atrainam indra vṛtrahann ugro marmaṇi vidhya | atraivainam abhi tiṣṭha śakra medy ahaṃ tava | anu tvendrā rabhāmahe syāma sumatau tava ||
english: Here, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, pierce him fiercely in his vital spot. Here indeed stand over him, O Śakra; I am your ally. We take hold of you, O Indra; may we be in your good grace.

sanskrit: yathendra udvācanaṃ labdhvā cakre adhaspadam | kṛṇve 'mum adharaṃ tathā śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
english: Just as Indra, having obtained the formal utterance, placed him beneath his foot — so I make that one inferior for all ages to come.
